Gene Set Scoring Backends

Source: R/64-BenchGeneScore.R
BenchGeneScoreSeuratMethod.Rd

Internal implementations behind BenchGeneScore.Seurat(), one per supported value of its method argument. They share the same interface and only differ in the backend they wrap, hence the common documentation.

BenchGeneScoreSeurat.<method>() is not meant to be called directly: it is reached through the class that BenchGeneScore.Seurat() sets on method before dispatching.

Usage

BenchGeneScoreSeurat.ssGSEA(
  obj,
  pathway,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  ...,
  verbose = getFuncOption("verbose")
)

BenchGeneScoreSeurat.AUCell(
  obj,
  pathway,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  ...,
  verbose = getFuncOption("verbose")
)

BenchGeneScoreSeurat.UCell(
  obj,
  pathway,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  ...,
  verbose = getFuncOption("verbose")
)

BenchGeneScoreSeurat.AddModuleScore(
  obj,
  pathway,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  ...,
  verbose = getFuncOption("verbose")
)

Arguments

obj

A Seurat object.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to the wrapped backend.

verbose

Logical. Whether to print progress information. Default: getFuncOption("verbose").

Value

The score matrix of the wrapped backend, with gene sets in rows and cells in columns, except "AUCell", which returns the AUCell::AUCell_calcAUC() object whose AUC matrix uses the same layout.

Details

Expression values are always taken with SeuratObject::LayerData(), so the backend receives a plain gene-by-cell matrix. Each backend then does its own housekeeping:

  • ssGSEA splits ... between GSVA::ssgseaParam() and GSVA::gsva();

  • AUCell splits ... between AUCell::AUCell_buildRankings() and AUCell::AUCell_calcAUC(), and builds the rankings with plotStats = FALSE;

  • UCell passes everything to UCell::ScoreSignatures_UCell() with name = "" so that gene-set names stay untouched, then transposes the cell-by-gene-set result;

  • AddModuleScore keeps only the genes present in assay, drops the gene sets that become empty, and aborts when none of them is left.

See also

BenchGeneScore()
